test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with respect to the Schedules of the Indian Constitution?

options.text: Eleventh Schedule - Powers and responsibilities of Panchayats
Twelfth Schedule - Election of President and Vice-President
Ninth Schedule Allocation of powers between Union and States

solution:
The correct answer is __**Eleventh Schedule - Powers and responsibilities of Panchayats**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Eleventh Schedule** of the Indian Constitution was added through the **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992**.
 
• It contains a list of **29 functional items** related to the powers, authority, and responsibilities of Panchayats.
 
• The schedule emphasizes the **decentralization of governance** by empowering Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs) to manage local self-governance effectively.
 
• Key areas include agriculture, rural development, water management, social forestry, education, health, and public distribution systems.
 
• This initiative was a significant step to strengthen grassroots democracy and ensure **effective participation of local bodies** in governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Twelfth Schedule**

 
 
• Added through the **74th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992**, it lists **18 functional items** related to the powers and responsibilities of Urban Local Bodies (Municipalities).
 
• Focuses on areas like urban planning, slum improvement, public health, sanitation, and urban poverty alleviation.
 
 
 
• **Ninth Schedule**
 
 
• Introduced through the **First Constitutional Amendment Act of 1951**, it protects laws related to land reform and the abolition of the zamindari system from judicial review.
 
• It aims to uphold social justice and equitable distribution of resources.
 
 
 
• **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act**
 
 
• Enacted in 1992, it institutionalized Panchayati Raj in India by adding **Part IX** to the Constitution.
 
• Mandated the establishment of a three-tier system of Panchayati Raj Institutions (village, intermediate, and district levels).
 
• Introduced provisions for **direct elections**, reservation for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and women, and a fixed tenure of five years.
 
 
 
• **74th Constitutional Amendment Act**
 
 
• Introduced in 1992, it institutionalized Urban Local Bodies (Municipalities) by adding **Part IXA** to the Constitution.
 
• Strengthened the framework for decentralized governance in urban areas.
